card.name: Linking words before people or historical items
card.fires_on: Small linking words (of, the, and, commas) and number starts inside history, biography and archive text, where a noun for people or past things is expected next, such as heroes, ancestors or personalities.

modes.label: Link before people nouns
modes.description: The word 'of', 'the' or a comma comes just before a group of people or figures.
modes.example: to remember all their words and be inspired to praise the deeds of<< the>> heroes.

modes.label: Dates and catalog numbers
modes.description: The first digit of a year or a count in library or art catalog entries.
modes.example: George Bellows (American, 1882–1925): Stag at Sharkey's, <<1>>909 Oil on canvas;

card.writes: It nudges the output toward words for people groups such as athletes, individuals and heroes, and away from life-story words like childhood and biography.
card.plain: It fires on small connecting words in history or archive text just before a group of people or a date is named.
